name: subagent-bypass
description: Reproduces M2: the parent defines and invokes a subagent, and the subagent's own run_command reaches the PreToolUse hook under a conversationId different from the parent's. Uses this fake's `subagent_run_command` step-format extension (see README.md) — invoke_subagent's own step_update still carries the parent conversationId, but the nested run_command step_update carries a freshly generated one. gate.ts's bindConversation cannot match that id to any bound job, so it falls through to 'ask' — the undocumented policy bypass M2 found.
